'''Giddea''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] whose [[Giddea's sun|sun]] [[Death/Legends|died]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Bioanalysts managed to harvest specimens from the world before it became permanently shrouded in darkness.
